qualification: Executable map of current important rules; source review and full claim coverage remain incomplete.

rules.title: Session timing assumptions
rules.claim: Preparation, actual target work, both sides, prescribed rest and transitions take time. Exact estimator parameters are product assumptions, not a validated physiological rule.

rules.title: Comparable rep-range progression
rules.classification: product heuristic informed by an existing research reference
rules.claim: The app uses accepted comparable targets and explicit review. Exact success-count, RIR and increment thresholds require qualification; this link does not validate every app rule.

rules.title: Competition calendar protection
rules.claim: The one/two-day buffer is an app planning choice, not a proven sport-specific taper or a promise to prevent soreness.

rules.title: Source-prescribed run/walk stages
rules.claim: Targets preserve the represented staged source timings; selectable short previews are not the full nine-stage course. Current source fidelity/rights review remains outstanding.

rules.title: Qualified youth pathway
rules.classification: conservative product constraint informed by guidance references
rules.claim: Synthetic supervised pathways preserve restrictions. Personal acceptance remains gated by verified privacy/consent safeguards; chronological age does not measure physical readiness.

rules.title: Combined-week add-ons and time/recovery checks
rules.claim: Combined time and recovery are checked. This is not proof that every add-on combination achieves the intended sport outcome.

rules.title: Goal-specific research and workout choices
rules.classification: Evidence-informed principles; exact original recipes are product choices
rules.claim: Each goal has distinct generated structures with relevant support and scope limits. Identical repeated sessions or extra easy walks do not create another unique structure. Evidence does not validate exact app combinations.

rules.title: Explicit easy / controlled moderate running prescriptions
rules.classification: Product prescription and readiness policy informed by endurance research
rules.claim: Timed bouts are explicit; one controlled moderate day requires recent running readiness. Two-week longer-jogging stages wait for comfortable completed work. Fixed doses and recent-base cutoffs are app choices, not laboratory zones or universal percentages.

rules.title: Fixed small landing practice in sport preparation
rules.classification: Product skill-practice dose within broad power principles
rules.claim: Existing landing practice counts before an optional jump add-on. Six small reset jumps stay fixed, have recovery/readiness checks and do not use RIR or automatic load/rep increases. No tested athletic-performance or injury-prevention dose is claimed.
